llm_response.reason: The domain txexyxh.com was registered in July 2025, yet the website claims to operate since 2018—mismatched and deceptive. The site claims excessive benefits (zero handling fees, guaranteed deposit safety, ultra-high transaction speed, and guaranteed returns), which are classic scam tactics. The contact email uses a different domain ('mail.txexbt.com'), raising further suspicion. There are vague claims of regulatory compliance with an unverifiable reference to an MSB registration link, with no proof of actual licensing. The overall branding and domain are inconsistent with legitimate, long-running cryptocurrency exchanges. These indicators fulfill multiple scam criteria: non-existent company history, psychological urgency, improbable offers, ambiguous privacy notation, and domain name-brand mismatch.
